name: uberllm
description: Official UberLLM MCP server: list models with current prices, quote a request before running it, generate and edit images, start video jobs and wait for them, and check the prepaid balance.

UBERLLM_API_KEY.description: UberLLM API key (starts with ull_). Tool calls that generate media spend prepaid credit; there is no free tier.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Your balance in US dollars: what you can spend now and what is held for requests and jobs still running.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Change a picture you give (image_url or input_images, as https:// links or data: URIs) following a prompt, with an editing model. Spends from your balance.

size.description: Width x height, e.g. 1024x1024, when the model lists sizes.

aspect_ratio.description: Shape, e.g. 16:9, when the model lists aspect ratios.

max_cost.description: The most you will pay in US dollars; a request that can cost more is refused before anything is spent.

return_image.description: Also return the pictures themselves in the answer, so you can look at them.

options.description: Any other option from get_model's parameters schema.

image_url.description: The picture to change: an https:// link or a data: URI.

input_images.description: Several pictures to work from (https:// links or data: URIs).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Make pictures from a prompt. Spends from your balance; the answer carries the links and what it cost (usage.cost_usd).

size.description: Width x height, e.g. 1024x1024, when the model lists sizes.

aspect_ratio.description: Shape, e.g. 16:9, when the model lists aspect ratios.

max_cost.description: The most you will pay in US dollars; a request that can cost more is refused before anything is spent.

return_image.description: Also return the pictures themselves in the answer, so you can look at them.

options.description: Any other option from get_model's parameters schema.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: The status of a video or music job, its progress and, once it succeeded, the links to its files and what it cost.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model: its price, what it makes and, for an image, video, music or speech model, a JSON Schema of the options a request takes (parameters).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Models you can call right now, with their price. Filter by type (chat, image, video, music, speech, transcription) and by words in the id or name.

type.description: Only models of this type: chat, image, video, music, speech or transcription.

search.description: Only models whose id or name contains these words, e.g. seedance or kling.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Check an image, video, music or text-to-speech request against the model and price it, without making anything or spending. Returns the listed price (cost_usd: it is never billed more) and what is held while it runs (max_cost_usd).

options.description: The rest of the request, as get_model's parameters schema describes it, e.g. {"duration_seconds": 5, "image_url": "https://..."}.

tools.name: start_video
tools.description: Start making a video. Returns a job; call wait_job with its id until it is done. Spends from your balance when the video is made; a failed job costs nothing.

image_url.description: The first frame (https:// link or data: URI); needed by image-to-video models.

end_image_url.description: The last frame, for models that make a transition.

duration_seconds.description: Length in seconds; one of the lengths get_model lists.

resolution.description: e.g. 720p, when the model lists resolutions.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. 16:9, when the model lists aspect ratios.

max_cost.description: The most you will pay in US dollars; a job that can cost more is refused before anything is spent.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key when you retry, so a retry never starts or pays for a second video.

options.description: Any other option from get_model's parameters schema.

tools.name: wait_job
tools.description: Wait until a video or music job ends, for at most timeout_seconds (50 at most). Returns the job; if done is false, call wait_job again.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait, 1 to 50 seconds. Default 50.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP with a bearer API key.
